mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an accommodative monetary policy shift that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.10 percentage points over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 6.0% indicates labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 6.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous expansion in housing starts (HOUST > 1500) and real consumption (RSAFS > 550000) signals robust aggregate demand, which increases corporate revenue expectations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST > 1500 and RSAFS > 550000.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansions, a monthly decline in industrial production (INDPRO) exceeding 0.5% signals manufacturing contraction, which reduces corporate profit growth and causes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO declines by >0.5% during late-cycle expansions.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals labor market strengthening that boosts consumer spending and corporate profit growth, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS increases by at least 100,000 jobs.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) exceeding 2.5% signals persistent inflation, which increases the likelihood of Federal Reserve rate hikes and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY change exceeds 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) above 1.0% and housing starts (HOUST) above 1500 thousand units signal strong economic momentum, which increases corporate profit expectations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both GDPC1 growth rate > 1.0% and HOUST > 1500.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles, a federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 0.5% combined with a year-over-year CPI increase (CPIAUCSL) exceeding 2.0% indicates aggressive inflation control, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 0.5% and CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.0% during monetary tightening cycles.
